label: Demo data: Amberkloof is an invented brand · category-only request, no website

request.category: small-batch botanical body care (marula face oil, rooibos body butter)

target.note: The hero brand Amberkloof is invented and has no website; the request names its category and area only (PROVISIONAL, spine D-06).

text:
**Assumptions:** Path B with web search only. No GSC, since no site was given. No volume or difficulty data, so intent and fit are judgement calls from public pages. The Pretoria-East angle is a local-modifier test. Competitors found: Afrakari (via Skinmiles), Essentially Natural (via PriceCheck) and Wolkewinkel.

| # | Keyword target | Intent | Why it fits Amberkloof | Competitor source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | pure marula oil South Africa | Transactional | Core product. Afrakari lists R900 pure oil. | [Afrakari](https://skinmiles.com/product/afrakari-pure-marula-oil/) |
| 2 | marula face oil Pretoria | Transactional, local | Skinmiles offers Pretoria collection. Amberkloof is a true local. | [Skinmiles](https://skinmiles.com/product/afrakari-pure-marula-oil-cape-chamomile/) |
| 3 | cold pressed marula oil 100ml | Transactional | A size-specific query, and Essentially Natural targets it. Small batch lets you stress "cold-pressed". | [PriceCheck](https://www.pricecheck.co.za/offers/146143174/Marula+Oil+-+Cold+Pressed+-+100ML) |
| 4 | marula oil for face | Informational/commercial | Essentially Natural pitches one oil for face, body and hair. You can own "face-specific". | [PriceCheck](https://www.pricecheck.co.za/offers/172183125) |
| 5 | marula oil cape chamomile | Commercial | Blend-style query. Shows demand for botanical pairings. | [Afrakari](https://skinmiles.com/product/afrakari-pure-marula-oil-cape-chamomile/) |
| 6 | rooibos body butter | Transactional | Core product. Wolkewinkel ranks with scent variants. | [Wolkewinkel](https://wolkewinkel.shopstar.co.za/products/rooibos-tea-body-butter) |
| 7 | rooibos body butter South Africa | Transactional | Country-level version. Black African Organics lists R140 for 250ml. | [Beauty on Tapp](https://beautyontapp.com/products/black-african-organics-triple-african-body-butter-with-rooibos) |
| 8 | handmade rooibos skincare | Commercial | Marice Mercuur is the only explicit "handmade" claim I found. Amberkloof can match it. | [Bizcommunity](https://www.Bizcommunity.com/Company/MariceMercuur) |
| 9 | shea cocoa butter body butter rooibos | Commercial | An ingredient-led long-tail query. It suits a comparison page. | [Beauty on Tapp](https://beautyontapp.com/products/black-african-organics-triple-african-body-butter-with-rooibos) |
| 10 | small batch natural body care South Africa | Commercial | Brand-positioning term. Bulk Body Care targets it. | [Bulk Body Care](https://bulkbodycare.co.za/body-and-beauty) |

**Gap:** I found no Pretoria-East-specific competitor page for rooibos body butter. Rows 2 and 6 combined with "Pretoria East" look like the easiest local wins.

**Next:** Build a "marula face oil Pretoria" landing page first. It takes about 30 minutes.
